Applicants who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Fully Remote / Work From Anywhere&nbsp;<br><strong>Schedule: </strong>US Central Time, Monday–Friday (Full-Time)<br><strong>Compensation: </strong>$2,500–$3,500/month</p> <h2><strong><br>Overview</strong></h2> <p>Integrated Hire (integratedhire.com) helps small and mid-sized U.S. businesses build high-performing remote teams by connecting them with experienced offshore professionals across administration, finance, customer service, marketing, operations, and more.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Client Services and Client Success Manager who is highly organized, responsive, and excellent at keeping clients happy. This is not primarily a sales role. The focus is on onboarding, client communication, follow-up, problem solving, and making sure the client experience stays smooth from the moment a client signs through the hiring process and beyond.</p> <p>A significant part of this role involves stepping in when things do not go according to plan. You may be handling an unhappy client, employee performance or attendance concerns, communication breakdowns, or other unexpected issues. You’ll take ownership, coordinate with the right people internally, and help drive each situation toward a resolution.</p> <p>This role is best suited for someone who is calm under pressure, strong with follow-through, comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients, and able to manage many moving pieces without letting anything fall through the cracks.</p> <p>We’re open to experienced professionals based anywhere in the United States or abroad, provided they can consistently work U.S. business hours and communicate naturally and confidently with U.S. business owners.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Client Issue Resolution &amp; Problem Solving</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Take ownership of client issues and drive them through resolution</li> <li>Manage situations involving employee performance, attendance, communication problems, client dissatisfaction, replacements, and other service issues</li> <li>Communicate directly with clients to understand concerns, set expectations, and determine next steps</li> <li>Coordinate with recruitment, leadership, and other team members to resolve problems quickly</li> <li>Handle sensitive or difficult conversations professionally while maintaining strong client relationships</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Client Onboarding &amp; Handover</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead or join onboarding calls after a new client signs and manage a smooth handover from sales to delivery</li> <li>Confirm and document client requirements, expectations, and timelines for the internal team</li> <li>Set the tone for a professional, organized client experience from day one</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Client Communication &amp; Retention</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as the main point of contact for clients through recruitment, placement, and beyond</li> <li>Run regular check-ins and updates on search progress, interviews, and next steps</li> <li>Answer client questions with clear guidance on process, documentation, and timelines</li> <li>Stay proactive after hires are made by flagging concerns, risks, and expansion opportunities</li> <li>Keep clients seeing Integrated Hire as a reliable long-term partner</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Interview &amp; Recruitment Coordination</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Coordinate interview scheduling between clients, candidates, and recruiters</li> <li>Monitor client interviews to ensure attendance</li> <li>Jump in on scheduling, access, or technical issues in real time</li> <li>Collect post-interview feedback and share it clearly with the team</li> </ul>
